headline: Ed-Fi Summit Opens as AI Fluency Meets AI-Free Writing
thesis: As Ed-Fi's Summit opens on shared data, campuses are rethinking what AI should and shouldn't touch, and the evidence base is still thin.
summary: Inside Higher Ed's Nov 9 AI roundup reports that the University of Chicago will require all first-years to take an AI-free writing course while Eastern Illinois students petition against classroom AI. Brookings' task force argues that AI's risks currently outweigh its benefits for students and that evidence methods must speed up, echoing IHE's piece on the thin research base. The Ed-Fi Summit (Nov 9–11) opens with state case studies on attendance, transfers and reporting, and 1EdTech's Nov 12 Labs session asks what GenAI must prove.
